causalLimits: one declared seed and near-midnight state, not a balance estimate
C uses the original thirty-minute gather batch while other waiting uses advance(1); NPC/enemy batch effects are reported, not erased
the old candidate defense plan settles at midnight in all branches; its effects remain separate from ration and choice
a pending episode and exhausted cache are facts, not an executed skip or automatic punishment
no claim that resonance +2 directly spawns an enemy, assigns a trip or creates an away roster

findings.qualification: A closes its original episode; D keeps it pending. The measured extra collapse has no measured food, HP, energy or resonance benefit at this horizon; this does not assign a value to clearing a pending task.

findings.topic: abstract finite cache versus map supply labor
findings.qualification: Forage spends the unique cache and adds resonance; it does not implement a trip, travel-time cost, away roster or immediate enemy spawn in this observed action.

findings.topic: deferred episode after crossing the original opening threshold
findings.qualification: The extra later choice is a separate writer branch, not part of policy C at midnight. Keeping an optional episode is distinct from executing skip or auto-completing it.

findings.topic: finite cache across actual writer reload and next-day episode
findings.qualification: No new cache, refund or hidden reward was created by the probe.

findings.topic: ration request versus actual paid food
findings.qualification: The source return of three is not used as a claim that all three food were actually paid.

findings.topic: authored action batching changes the surrounding simulation
findings.qualification: C has one original thirty-minute gather batch plus ten one-minute calls; the others have forty one-minute calls. Enemy/NPC differences cannot be attributed solely to food acquisition or interpreted as a safer policy.
A null target ID in the original wrapper receipt is retained. The experiment does not fill that missing field or fabricate a stronger collection proof.

outcomesNotImplementedByThisScript: no new skip penalty or ration benefit
no trip, away duty or extra enemy spawned to dramatize forage
no direct day assignment after boot, fabricated effect receipt, balance threshold or natural-run claim
